authorRole.en: Publisher of a free VIN decoder that reads NHTSA and EPA records without a paid report

authorDesc.en: Radif Partners runs this decoder on four federal sources you can query yourself: the NHTSA vPIC database that carmakers fill under 49 CFR Part 565, the NHTSA recall campaigns filed under Part 573, the NCAP crash-test ratings, and the EPA fuel economy records on fueleconomy.gov. Your VIN goes from your browser to those agencies and to nobody else; there is no account, no email and no history report to buy.

description: Free VIN decoder for US vehicles: factory specs from NHTSA vPIC, recall campaigns, NCAP crash ratings and EPA mpg in one page, with no paid report.
